archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: PCS
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation: Feeder system that writes financial/operational data into the eFin database. Flagged as the highest-risk feeder system in this architecture, as it is not hosted within Azure but sits in a separate VPC/subnet, increasing the attack surface relative to the other feeder systems.

properties.value: Elevated — not part of the Azure-hosted estate; direct DB access to eFin
